name: Multan district (suburban) private bus routes
notes: 9 routes from Multan's two bus terminals (Dera Adda, General Bus Stand) to district towns, listed in the 2012 Integrated Master Plan. Endpoints only. Marked unverified: these suburban services are plausibly still running but no 2020s source was checked.

routes.notes: Suburban/district bus route. Stops = named points in printed order; not a formal stop list. Government e-bus/feeder MFR04B Nishter Hospital - Shujabad covers the same corridor.
